generation.scope: No finite-Frobenius window has point graph a smooth nonhyperelliptic sextic of genus three with point projection fibers. The determinantal cubic forces its length-two rank drop onto a trisecant, yielding a fixed-point-free automorphism and a Jacobian identity. These force the Fermat plane quartic and one of thirty polarization sequences. Exact good reduction bounds every cubic overlap by two.

open_mathematics: Work on the hyperelliptic sextic via its intrinsic ruling and two binary pencils; include degree-six genus and isolated residual constraints, then address the remaining smooth quintics and reducible point schemes.
